input: Ten ordinary keyboard characters: electronic, followed by submit
network_condition: No artificial response delay; identical ordinary search responses in both variants
scope: Successful search JSON response-body bytes written and flushed by the isolated ordinary backend during the native input action. Excludes image bodies, HTTP headers, and unrelated external home-page requests. Not a radio-byte or CPU-improvement claim.
functional_requirements: Native input begins empty and ends with the full query
Native results contain the expected song titles, creators, and durations
Every recorded response body matches the ordinary catalogue query exactly and is fully sent
Unfixed completes all ten prefix searches plus submit; fixed completes one or two full-query searches and no prefix searches
Same native application process throughout each action; identical signed business source except ordinary endpoint and existing debounce fix
Same live service process and unchanged complete catalogue verified before and after each trial
